items.title: 61521_David Albert Francis oral history interview
items.q: Oh, yeah -- we had Besford Hendrix, Burt Keys, Leroy Kirkland, Joe Mooney.

ctx.x: You were really -- everybody depended on you to create the sounds, whatever rhythm pattern that we were going to put behind the singer -- even the arrangers -- name some of the arrangers. We had Besford Hendrix, and ..
Oh, yeah -- we had Besford Hendrix, Burt Keys, Leroy Kirkland, Joe Mooney.
Name that young man that died that lived in New Jersey that was such a beautiful person, a West Indian black man.
